question: What does Sripurva say of kala-to-unmanifest?
premises: in Sripurva, from kala-tattva the unmanifest, so said
inference: Sripurva: unmanifest from kala; unmarked from night-become-Kali.
plain_english: In Sripurva, from kala-tattva the unmanifest, so said — from that indeed, from night-named Kali-become, unmarked.
